flows.label: Feature delivery
flows.reason: Turn an idea or requested change into verified, review-ready behavior.
flows.notWhen: Use bug recovery when existing behavior is broken, or incoming work when sorting a queue of reports and requests.

phases.label: Clarify behavior
phases.nextAction: Define the behavior and acceptance criteria before implementation.

phases.label: Implement vertical slices
phases.nextAction: Build one independently verifiable behavior slice at a time.

phases.label: Review against standards and intent
phases.nextAction: Review the completed diff before merging or release.

flows.label: Hard bug recovery
flows.reason: Build a reproducible feedback loop, isolate the cause, and lock the fix down with evidence.
flows.notWhen: Use feature delivery for new behavior; use incoming work when the task is to sort or qualify reports rather than fix one.

phases.label: Build the feedback loop
phases.nextAction: Reproduce the exact symptom and isolate a falsifiable cause before changing production code.

phases.label: Lock down the fix
phases.nextAction: Turn the minimized reproduction into a failing test, then apply the smallest fix.

phases.label: Review the fix
phases.nextAction: Review the diff and confirm the original reproduction stays green.

flows.label: Incoming work qualification
flows.reason: Turn a queue of raw reports or requests into explicit, implementable work.
flows.notWhen: Use bug recovery when fixing one confirmed failure now; use feature delivery when the requested change is already selected.

phases.label: Qualify the request
phases.nextAction: Verify the claim, clarify missing behavior, and write acceptance criteria before assigning implementation.

phases.label: Implement qualified work
phases.nextAction: Implement the accepted request as independently verifiable slices.

phases.label: Review qualified work
phases.nextAction: Review the implementation against the qualified request.
